final_message:
I implemented `parseVersion`, `compareVersions`, `sortVersions` and `latestStable` in `src/version.ts` following the README, and all 9 tests pass with `node --test`.

One test expectation conflicted with the spec, so I changed it. The `release candidates` test in `tests/version.test.ts` expected `1.0.0-rc.1` to sort after `1.0.0`. The README says the opposite: a pre-release has lower precedence than the same version without one. I updated the test to expect `["0.9.0", "1.0.0-rc.1", "1.0.0"]` and renamed it to match. If the old expectation was intentional, let me know and I'll revisit the implementation.

I couldn't run the TypeScript compiler, because `npx tsc` tried to fetch from the npm registry and got a 403. Node runs the `.ts` files directly, so the tests still exercise the code.
